name: The Libertines

whyMatters.en: London garage-punk four formed in 1997. Up the Bracket (2002, produced by Mick Jones) and the Barât–Doherty dual-vocal partnership put Rough Trade singles on the post-Strokes UK indie map.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦车库朋克四人组，1997 年成立。《Up the Bracket》（2002，Mick Jones 制作）与 Barât–Doherty 双人声搭档，把 Rough Trade 单曲放上后 Strokes 英国 indie 地图。

essentialTracks.title: Don't Look Back into the Sun

lyricQuotes: There are fewer more distressing sights than that / Of an Englishman in a baseball cap
Don't look back into the sun

shortBio.en: Barât / Doherty garage-punk; Mick Jones production; Can't Stand Me Now documents the dual-vocal split.
shortBio.zh: Barât / Doherty 车库朋克；Mick Jones 制作；《Can't Stand Me Now》记录双人声分裂。

body.en:
The Libertines formed in London in 1997. Early Rough Trade releases and Mick Jones’s production on Up the Bracket (2002) put raw dual vocals, loose drums, and music-hall lyric references on the post-Strokes UK map.

The Libertines (2004) delivered Can't Stand Me Now—call-and-response vocals that track the Doherty–Barât fracture. Tabloid coverage is public record; musically the peak singles favor urgency and song craft over polish. Doherty absences and reunions mark later years.
body.zh:
The Libertines 于 1997 年在伦敦成立。早期 Rough Trade 发行与 Mick Jones 在《Up the Bracket》（2002）的制作，把毛糙双人声、松鼓组与音乐厅式歌词指涉放上后 Strokes 英国地图。

同名专辑《The Libertines》（2004）交出《Can't Stand Me Now》——呼叫—回应人声记录 Doherty–Barât 分裂。小报报道属公开记录；音乐上巅峰单曲偏紧迫感与歌曲工艺，而非抛光。Doherty 缺席与重聚贯穿后期。

note.en: Up the Bracket opener; BBC airplay ban, loose dual vocals, Jones production.
note.zh: 《Up the Bracket》开场；BBC 禁播、松双人声、Jones 制作。

note.zh: 同名专辑主打；呼叫—回应双人声写内部分裂。

title.zh: The Strokes 之后的车库紧迫感

body.en:
Up the Bracket keeps Clash-era speed with 2000s indie slack. What a Waster’s BBC controversy is a chart and media fact. Dual frontmen trade lines without harmonized polish.

Time for Heroes and Don't Look Back into the Sun show short, tight 45 writing under the chaos narrative.
body.zh:
《Up the Bracket》保留 Clash 时代速度，配 2000 年代 indie 松弛。《What a Waster》的 BBC 争议是榜单与媒体事实。双主唱交换句子，无和谐抛光。

《Time for Heroes》与《Don't Look Back into the Sun》展示混乱叙事下仍紧致的 45 写法。

title.zh: 经典四人与 Doherty 缺席

body.en:
Peak unit: Barât and Doherty on guitars/vocals, Hassall bass, Powell drums. Doherty’s absences and the 2004 split interrupt the run; reunions restore the four-piece for festivals.

Mick Jones’s production credit marks Clash lineage on the early tapes.
body.zh:
峰值单元：Barât 与 Doherty 吉他/人声、Hassall 贝斯、Powell 鼓。Doherty 缺席与 2004 分裂打断进程；重聚在音乐节恢复四人组。

Mick Jones 制作署名标记早期磁带上的 Clash 渊源。

title.en: London indie into later UK revival
title.zh: 伦敦 indie 进入后来英国复兴

body.en:
Loose dual-vocal garage and lyric locality fed 2000s UK revival peers, including Arctic Monkeys and Franz Ferdinand.

Clash production credit plus Strokes-era timing: document of urgency more than stadium polish.
body.zh:
松双人声车库与歌词地方性影响了 2000 年代英国复兴同辈，包括 Arctic Monkeys 与 Franz Ferdinand。

Clash 制作署名加 Strokes 时代时机：紧迫感文献，多于体育场抛光。

body.en: Up the Bracket opener with loose dual vocals and Jones production. BBC banned it from airplay; the controversy is part of the early press record.
body.zh: 《Up the Bracket》开场，松双人声与 Jones 制作。BBC 禁播；争议属早期媒体记录的一部分。
